decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on  7/5/2007 when the use shall cease

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to 101 High Street shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 4 - The change of use hereby approved shall include retention of the shop window.
description: Change of use to community european office use
